title: Context-Horizonized Reservoir Sampler for FP8/INT8 Calibration Packs
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Problem: Our current per-domain calibration packs over-index on recent high-volume intents and fail to represent long-tail intents and multi-turn context lengths that materially affect FP8/INT8 quantization error. This leads to underestimation of accuracy regressions in production for specific domains (e.g., legal, finance, multi-turn chat) and suboptimal quant profiles.

Proposal: Implement a context-horizonized reservoir sampling pipeline that builds per-domain calibration packs by (1) horizonizing the context window around prompts to preserve variable-length conversational context, (2) maintaining a dual reservoir per domain that balances recency and exemplar diversity, and (3) applying a gradient-informed importance weight calculated from comparative model deltas (FP32 vs INT8/FP8) on a lightweight probe model to prioritize high-impact examples. Augment rare-intent examples with perturbation-based paraphrases and deterministic slot-preserving substitutions to increase robustness without changing intent semantics. The result: compact, cost-efficient per-domain packs (configurable pack_size) with measurable coverage across intent frequency, context-length strata, and semantic diversity.
acceptance_criteria: Generate per-domain packs (default pack_size=2000) for the top 30 production domains with metrics published to Console
Per-domain length-distribution KS distance to production traffic < 0.06 for tokenized prompt length
Tail-intent coverage (frequency < 0.1%) >= 75% of unique tail intents present across packs for respective domain
FP8/INT8 median delta (accuracy metric defined by eval harness) aligned with FP32 baseline within defined thresholds on > 95% of sampled holdout prompts
Automated pipeline runs in < 2 hours for 30 domains on dedicated calibration cluster and emits reproducible pack artifact and provenance metadata
implementation_plan: 1) Data pull: define SQL job to extract 90-day production prompts with metadata (domain, tenant, timestamp, intent, dialog_turn_index, token_length)
2) Feature compute: precompute embeddings, intent clusters, normalized token lengths, and a compact fingerprint for de-duplication
3) Horizonization: select variable-length context windows centered on target turn with distribution matching per-domain context-length histogram

4) Dual-reservoir sampling: maintain two buckets per domain — RECENCY reservoir (time-decayed probability) and DIVERSITY reservoir (utility-weighted reservoir via importance score), final sample = stratified draw between reservoirs by domain-configurable ratio

5) Importance weighting: run lightweight probe quantized model on a 10k pilot set to compute delta score = dist(output_fp32, output_quant) and scale selection probability by clipped log(delta + epsilon)
6) Augmentation: for rare-intents, generate paraphrases (3x) using constrained template substitution and round-trip paraphrase filtering to preserve label integrity
7) Pack assembly: enforce quotas (min_unique_sessions, max_dup_fraction, contextual_turn_mix) and produce cataloged artifact with checksum and provenance
8) Validation: run quantized model eval harness against pack, compute accuracy deltas, and store per-example diagnostic traces to S3 for triage
9) Automation: implement as airflow DAG + k8s batch steps; expose parameterized job in Console (pack_size, recency_ratio, augmentation_factor)
10) Rollout: pilot 10 domains -> iterate based on metrics -> production rollout to top 30 domains
sampling_algorithm_pseudocode:
# Pseudocode:
# For each domain D:
#  1) Extract candidate pool C from last N days with metadata
#  2) Compute fingerprint, de-dup, compute embedding and token_length
#  3) Horizonize: for each candidate pick context window length L sampled from domain_histogram(token_length) and materialize context
#  4) For each candidate compute importance_score = clip(log(1 + delta_probe), -2, 5) * (1 + entropy_normalized)
#  5) Add to RECENCY reservoir with weight = exponential_decay(age, lambda_recency)
#  6) Add to DIVERSITY reservoir with weight = importance_score / (1 + cluster_density)
#  7) Draw stratified sample S: s_recency = floor(pack_size * recency_ratio), s_diversity = pack_size - s_recency
#  8) If tail intents underquota, boost selection probability for rare intents up to augmentation_factor
#  9) Return S with provenance and diagnostic buckets
dataset_metrics: domain_coverage_percent: percent of domain sessions represented
intent_tail_coverage: percent of unique intents with freq<0.1% present
length_distribution_ks: KS distance vs production token length histogram
context_turn_mix: percent single-turn vs multi-turn (>=2 turns)
validation_plan: Holdout: reserve chronologically-split 10% holdout per-domain not used in sampling for final validation
Run quantized evaluation: compare model outputs on pack and holdout between FP32 and target quant (INT8/FP8) using evaluation harness (exact-match, BLEU, embedding-similarity)
Per-example triage: mark examples where delta > threshold and link to diagnostic traces for debugging
Regression gates: if median_delta increases by > 1.5x relative to baseline or worst_10_delta exceeds SLO, block quant profile promotion
A/B smoke: small production A/B (1% traffic) with model fallback policy to detect live regressions post-apply
test_plan: Unit tests: reservoir insertion/removal, importance_score computation, dedup fingerprinting
Integration tests: end-to-end DAG run on synthetic dataset (small) verifying pack artifact shape and metrics
Performance: timing benchmarks to ensure 30-domain run completes < 2 hours on calibration cluster
Golden-file test: deterministic pack output given seed and config; checksum must match expected for regression detection
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pilot): run 10 domains (low-risk) and validate metrics + manual triage (2 weeks)
Phase 1: expand to top 30 domains and enable automated pack generation in Console (1 month)
Phase 2: wire packs into quant profile tuning job and set promotion gating with signal from runtime-1.19 canary tests (2 weeks)
Phase 3: full automated cadence (weekly packs) with alerts and audit logs for pack changes
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overfitting packs to probe model deltas, missing orthogonal failure modes. Mitigation: ensemble probe models (diverse architectures) and keep separate random holdouts for blind validation.
Risk: Augmentation introduces label drift. Mitigation: constrain augmentation templates, perform round-trip paraphrase filtering, and cap augmentation ratio per intent.
Risk: Large-scale compute cost during importance scoring. Mitigation: use lightweight quantized probe and sample-first-then-score strategy; cache probe results between runs.
Risk: Privacy/regulatory constraints for certain domains. Mitigation: enforce domain-level redaction rules and provide leak-detection during pack assembly.

notes: This approach focuses on producing compact, high-signal packs that expose quantization failure modes relevant to production traffic. The emphasis on horizonized context windows and importance-weighted selection is intended to reduce false negatives during profile validation while keeping pack sizes cost-effective. Next actions: finalize probe model ensemble, schedule pilot run for March 15, and add audit metadata schema for pack provenance.
